Security awareness training

[Novee’s research team identified this high-severity vulnerability](https://novee.security/blog/cursor-ide-cve-2026-26268-git-hook-arbitrary-code-execution/) after studying how Cursor’s AI agent behavior interacts with untrusted external inputs.

The team, led by vulnerability researcher Assaf Levkovich, found that the root cause is not a flaw in Cursor’s core codebase.

Instead, it comes from a combination of two legitimate Git features that, when placed together in the right way, create a dangerous path for exploitation.
Cursor published the vulnerability in February 2026, following responsible disclosure and full coordination with Novee prior to publication.
